screenshots.name: 01-weak-point
screenshots.caption: FIND THE WEAK POINT
screenshots.alt: A muscled demolition man knocks out a support column and a furnished row house flies apart into bricks and beams.

screenshots.name: 02-tower
screenshots.caption: TOPPLE THE TOWER
screenshots.alt: A tall dockside crane tower collapses onto the street.

screenshots.name: 03-co-op
screenshots.caption: WRECK IT WITH A FRIEND
screenshots.alt: Two demolition men wreck a dockside cannery together while its walls and floors come down around them.

screenshots.name: 04-dynamite
screenshots.caption: BRING DYNAMITE
screenshots.alt: A stick of dynamite explodes against a neon-lit building at night and the floors above start to fall.

screenshots.name: 05-wrecking-ball
screenshots.caption: SWING THE WRECKING BALL
screenshots.alt: A wrecking ball swings through the glass front of a neon arcade.

screenshots.name: 06-cities
screenshots.caption: 3 CITIES + A DAILY STREET
screenshots.alt: The level select with three cities, Town, Port and Neon City, four streets each, plus a daily street and a ranked board.

screenshots.name: 07-three-stars
screenshots.caption: WRECK IT ALL FOR 3 STARS
screenshots.alt: The results screen after a street: three gold stars for 95% demolition, a first clear, the score, cash earned and the job sheet.

screenshots.name: 08-looks
screenshots.caption: DRESS UP YOUR CREW
screenshots.alt: The crew looks shop: traffic signs for heads, outfits, chains, bracelets and tattoos, shown on both demolition men.
